question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Upgrade
solution:
The correct answer is '**Demote**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym for '**Upgrade**' is '**Demote**'.
 
• **Upgrade**: to change something so that it is of a higher standard. (किसी वस्‍तु के स्‍तर को उन्‍नत करना या का स्‍तरोन्‍नयन करना)
 
 
• *Example: **Upgrading** your computer software can be expensive.*
 
 
 
• **Demote**: to move somebody to a lower position or level, often as a punishment. [व्‍यक्ति के निचले पद या स्‍तर पर भेजना (प्रायः दंडस्‍वरूप), पदावनति करना]
 
 
• *Example: Teachers can choose to **demote** a student to a lower grade.*

 
 
 

**​Correct Answer:__** *Demote.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Advance**: to move forward. (आगे बढ़ना)
 
• **Lean**: to move the top part of your body and head forwards, backwards or to the side. (सिर और शरीर के ऊपर के भाग को आगे, पीछे या पार्श्वों की ओर गति करना; झुकना, झुक जाना)
 
• **Elevate**: to move somebody/something to a higher place or more important position. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऊँचा उठाना या उच्‍चतर पद पर पहुँचाना)
